# Gen AI Solutions

> Practical IT and AI for Irish businesses.

Gen AI Solutions is based in Tralee, Co. Kerry and serves businesses across Ireland. Services cover infrastructure and server setup, websites and maintenance, business email and everyday IT, and both private and online AI with integrations, automation and staff training.

AI work can use online services, local tools, self-hosted systems or a combination, selected around the task and data requirements. Private, offline and open-source options are available for sensitive information. Data handling depends on the agreed setup. AI outputs need human review. No legal advice or guaranteed compliance is offered.

## Practical starting projects

Infrastructure work can include local servers, workstations, shared storage, backup planning, virtual machines and suitable self-hosted services. Access, changes and handover are agreed before work begins.

Website work can include updates, broken-page repairs, hosting and domain configuration, performance improvements and scoped ongoing maintenance.

Business email work can include domain email, DNS, mail clients, device configuration and review before a proposed migration. Third-party subscriptions and licences are agreed separately.

AI projects include online tool setup, integrations and workflow automation, local assistants, question answering across approved documents with source references, transcription, AI readiness reviews and staff training. Sensitive data can stay on the organisation's hardware or controlled infrastructure when that is how the agreed system is designed. Online providers and data sharing are reviewed before use.

## Enquiries and pricing

Email support@gen-ai-solutions.com or request a 20-minute consultation through the contact page. A time is arranged by reply. Project work is quoted after a scope review. Historical AI guide prices are not current confirmed offers. Do not infer fixed prices, support response guarantees or round-the-clock availability.

Please do not send sensitive files through this form. We can arrange a secure review process.

The general contact form uses external FormSubmit processing and forwards enquiries to support@gen-ai-solutions.com in Zoho Mail. It is not an offline data workflow. The website does not load Google Analytics or send visitor analytics events. It stores a light/dark theme preference locally in the visitor's browser, as described in the privacy policy.
